name: The Script Matrix
oneLine: A diagram of three channels parents' ego states use to hand down script material: injunctions (Child to Child), counter-injunctions (Parent to Parent), and programme (Adult to Adult).
whatYouDid: You sorted one of Imran's father's lines into the right matrix slot - a verbal, content-ful Be Perfect command, which makes it a counter-injunction, not the injunction underneath it.

fromBook.quote: Messages which originate from mother's and father's Parent ego-states are called counterinjunctions... Messages sent from the Child ego-state of mother and father can be of two kinds: injunctions or permissions.

expand.definition: Claude Steiner's original matrix used 'injunction' and 'counterscript' rather than the now-standard 'counter-injunction' - the three-channel structure (Parent-to-Parent, Adult-to-Adult, Child-to-Child) is the same model wearing slightly different labels depending on the author.
expand.otherFraming: Steiner's own term for the whole complex of injunction plus the decisions made in compliance with it is 'counterscript,' which is broader than the single word 'counter-injunction' now used for the Parent-to-Parent channel alone.
expand.tryThisToday: Draw a blank matrix and fill in one real counter-injunction you can still hear in a specific parent's voice, verbatim, plus one 'here's how to...' programme message you learned by watching rather than being told.
